name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: One panel that folds away behind a trigger. Minimal by design: the panel slides, and if you ask for it, writes a margin brace beside its text. The chevron indicator turns over the same way the accordion's does.

a11y: The trigger is a button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; Enter and Space toggle it. Closed content is not rendered.
Give the trigger a name: visible text, or a `sr-only` span when it is an icon button.
The brace and the chevron are decoration (aria-hidden); state is told by aria-expanded.
Reduced motion opens and closes the panel at once.
meta.usage:
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleIndicator, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/ui/collapsible"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Collapsible className="w-[350px]">
      <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="link">
          Show details
          <CollapsibleIndicator />
        </Button>
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent bracket="curly">Folded away until you ask.</CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  )
}
